surveys.title: Survey — Part 1
questions: How do you feel when you're hit with an unexpected surprise? (I don't mind / Irritated / Excited for the new opportunity)
Constant change makes me: (Crazy / Uncomfortable / Excited)
There's constant drama in the office. How do you feel? (I try to keep calm, but sometimes... / I hate it / Doesn't bother me — I keep my cool)
My friends think I handle stress well. (Yes / No / I don't tell them)
When I have a problem, I... (Give up when it's too difficult / Like to have all of the answers / Explore until I find a solution)

surveys.title: Survey — Part 2 (continued)
questions: How do you feel about long-term commitment? (Run, run, RUN! / My bread and butter / My heart changes with the wind)
If I give you $100 and ask you to light it on fire, you would: (Burn it / Save it / Spend it)
When I think of networking, I: (Avoid it / Suck it up and do it / Get someone else to do it for me)
Sacrifice is important to making your dreams come true. (Absolutely, whatever it takes / It depends... / I'll get back to you on that one)
Finish the sentence: "Money is..." (Something to be managed and moved / The root of all evil / A currency that is used to get what I want)

surveys.title: Video takeaways
questions: What are some of your biggest takeaways from the video?

surveys.title: Thinking about failure
questions: What does failure mean to you now that you've had a chance to think about it?
What have you learned from the failures in your life?

surveys.title: Success and failure redefined
questions: Has your definition of success and failure changed at all?
What does success look like now, personally and for your business?
What does failure look like now, personally and for your business?

questions.question: True or false: Success looks the same for everyone
questions.optionA: True — Everyone wants to make lots of money!
questions.optionB: False — Everyone can have their own definition of success

questions.question: Who can you reach out to for support in building your business?
questions.optionA: Friends, family, community members, and professionals
questions.optionB: No one! It's all on me!

questions.question: According to panelist Donny Harper, from this lesson's panel discussion, the best way to manage expectations is by:
questions.optionA: Setting clear business goals and being flexible
questions.optionC: Make sure expectations are low so that you don't let yourself down
